newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-VCP downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-VCP downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it was downgrading Brazilian pulp and paper company Votorantim Celulose e Papel (VCP) to hold from buy.
-- It also recommended investors to swap VCP shares for pulp view of their current upside potential".
-- It set a price target for Klabin of 1,250 reais per 1,000 shares for the next six months, a rise of 25 percent. Meanwhile, VCP 1997 price target was raised to 30 reais.
-- VCP preferred shares were down 0.07 percent at 26.98 reais.
